record.question: Then her face was bowed.
options: Then her face has been bowed.
Her face was being bowed then.
Then she was bowing her face.
record.explanation: Answer D: Then she bowed her face.. The sentence is passive; option D gives an active clause with the subject performing the action. The wording “bowed her face” is somewhat unusual but preserves the apparent meaning. Independent check: This is the active counterpart: “her face” becomes the object of “bowed,” and the implied agent is “she.” Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/active-and-passive-voice. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
